title: Q-TEST-TIMEBOMB-2: drain the timebomb baseline (11 pinned-date tests over real-clock SQL windows)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** issueloop and queue --run, daily
**Done check:** grep:workers/tools/timebomb-baseline.json::"tests": \[\]
**Prediction:** timebomb_baseline == 0 within 336 h
**Status:** open

Residual of Q-TEST-TIMEBOMB-1. `node workers/tools/timebomb.mjs` lists 11 tests (core/packs/*, core/deploy/packs-route, packs/{analytics,drafts,email,social,video}) that pin `Date.parse('2026-11-1x')` while `core/packs/index.js` or their `pack.json` read probes use `datetime('now', '-N days')`. Remedy per test: start the clock relative to `Date.now()` (as `packs/cloud/cloud.test.js` does), run `npm test` in workers, and remove the test from `workers/tools/timebomb-baseline.json` in the same change (the test fails on a stale baseline entry).

size: M

**Closing probe:** `grep:workers/tools/timebomb-baseline.json::"tests": \[\]`
